question: For a bank database with customer transactions, calculate each customer's daily running balance (where deposits add to the balance and other transaction types subtract). For each customer and each day, compute the 30-day rolling average balance (only after having 30 days of data, and treating negative averages as zero). Then group these daily averages by month and find each customer's maximum 30-day average balance within each month. Sum these maximum values across all customers for each month. Consider the first month of each customer's transaction history as the baseline period and exclude it from the final results, presenting monthly totals of these summed maximum 30-day average balances.

WITH daily_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_date_range AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(txn_date)::DATE as first_date,
    MAX(txn_date)::DATE as last_date,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM MIN(txn_date)::DATE)::INTEGER as first_month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(txn_date)::DATE)::INTEGER as first_year_num
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT generate_series AS txn_date
  FROM generate_series('2020-01-01'::DATE, '2020-04-28'::DATE, INTERVAL '1 day')
),
customer_all_days AS (
  SELECT 
    cdr.customer_id,
    d.txn_date
  FROM customer_date_range cdr
  CROSS JOIN all_dates d
  WHERE d.txn_date BETWEEN cdr.first_date AND cdr.last_date
),
customer_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    cad.customer_id,
    cad.txn_date,
    COALESCE(da.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
  FROM customer_all_days cad
  LEFT JOIN daily_agg da ON cad.customer_id = da.customer_id AND cad.txn_date = da.txn_date
),
customer_running_balance AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    daily_net,
    SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
  FROM customer_daily
),
customer_with_rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    running_balance,
    AVG(running_balance) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id 
      ORDER BY txn_date 
      ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) as rolling_avg_30day,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as day_number
  FROM customer_running_balance
),
customer_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    cwa.*,
    cdr.first_month_num,
    cdr.first_year_num
  FROM customer_with_rolling_avg cwa
  JOIN customer_date_range cdr ON cwa.customer_id = cdr.customer_id
  WHERE cwa.day_number >= 30
),
customer_monthly_max AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date::DATE)::INTEGER as month_num,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date::DATE)::INTEGER as year_num,
    first_month_num,
    first_year_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rolling_avg_30day < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rolling_avg_30day END) as max_30day_avg
  FROM customer_filtered
  GROUP BY customer_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM txn_date::DATE), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM txn_date::DATE), first_month_num, first_year_num
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    year_num,
    month_num,
    SUM(max_30day_avg) as total_summed_max
  FROM customer_monthly_max
  WHERE NOT (year_num = first_year_num AND month_num = first_month_num)
  GROUP BY year_num, month_num
  ORDER BY year_num, month_num
)
SELECT 
  year_num,
  month_num,
  ROUND(total_summed_max, 2) as total_summed_max
FROM monthly_totals
